:label.title: 标签
:label.description: NovelScriptCommands uses ':' lines as jump targets.

adultui.title: 成人 UI 开关
adultui.description: NovelCmdAdultUI toggles the adult-scene overlay state.

uivisible.title: UI 可见性
uivisible.description: NovelCmdUIVisible toggles the common UI layer.

window.title: 文本窗口
window.description: NovelCmdWindow changes the message window visibility/fade.

fade.title: 画面淡入淡出
fade.description: NovelCmdFade drives the screen fade model.

message.title: 旁白/普通文本
message.description: NovelCmdMessage writes to NovelModelMessage and may play voice.

l2dmessage.title: Live2D 台词
l2dmessage.description: NovelCmdL2dMessage derives from NovelCmdMessage and ties speech to Live2D/lip sync.

l2dshow.title: 显示 Live2D
l2dshow.description: NovelCmdL2dShow loads and draws a NovelModelLive2D object.

l2dhide.title: 隐藏 Live2D
l2dhide.description: NovelCmdL2dHide releases the active Live2D model.

asyncl2dmotion.title: 延迟 Live2D 动作
asyncl2dmotion.description: Async wrapper schedules PlayMotion and finishes according to STOP/async code.

bgmplay.title: 播放 BGM
bgmplay.description: NovelCmdBGMPlay starts a CRI cue by tag.

bgmstop.title: 停止 BGM
bgmstop.description: NovelCmdBGMStop fades/stops a CRI cue by tag.

bgvplay.title: 播放背景语音/环境声
bgvplay.description: NovelCmdBGVPlay starts a CRI background-voice cue.

bgvstop.title: 停止背景语音/环境声
bgvstop.description: NovelCmdBGVStop fades/stops a CRI background-voice cue.

wait.title: 等待
wait.description: NovelCmdWait blocks script playback for the given seconds.
